name: Svitle Maybutnye
source:
The underground station 'Danko' is the last bastion of humanity after the atmosphere on the surface has become unsuitable for life, an ark that carries humanity through the thorns of the dangerous surrounding world.

Every day, on the territory of 30,000 km², thousands of automatic and semi-automatic mechanisms perform millions of processes to support the 'Bright Future' garden.

The sprouts of this agrarian are woven into an amazing and harmonious bouquet, where flowers experience their ideal future, where there are no conflicts and there is a shelter for everyone.

Such utopia could not exist without the titanic work of our atlanteans: five volunteer workers who took it upon themselves to watch over all of us.

One of such heroes is You, oh, great builder of civilization!

Always remember the weight on your shoulders and don't forget who you are, wear work clothes with confidence and complete the program to the max!

And most importantly, know:

When the future is out of reach, when the past seems so foreign, the only thing left is to live in the present.

[Translated from [url=https://plugara.itch.io/brightfuture]itch.io[/url]]
